prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a VERTICAL PORTRAIT illustration representing the calling of a Warden for The One Ring tabletop roleplaying artwork collection. Portrait aspect ratio 2:3, a full-body narrative character illustration with generous margins, not a square avatar.
An original adult human woman guardian, weathered and capable, stands watch at an old stone boundary gate overlooking a lonely path. Three-quarter view, calm vigilant expression, hair tied back, practical layered travelling tunic, worn wool cloak with hood down, leather bracers and sturdy boots. A modest round shield held at rest beside her, sheathed sword at belt, one natural hand rests on a tall wooden spear planted on ground. Her posture conveys patient protection and duty rather than aggression. Place her between the exposed winding path and a small peaceful homestead glimpsed behind a low wall, symbolizing safeguarding others. The guardian is main focus; distant hills, sparse tree and homestead only very faint line suggestions fading into paper. No battle or enemy, no heroic magical effects, no royal regalia.
Match the established approved collection: expressive fine warm muted brown pencil and pen contours, moderate selective directional hatching and limited crosshatching beneath cloak folds, hair recesses, shield edge and stone overlaps. Small rich umber shadow pockets and broad pale ivory paper highlights. Moderately simplified traditional fantasy book illustration; readable grouped hair locks and economical cloth folds, restrained plain gear. Avoid dense microtexture, smooth blended photographic shading, realistic skin pores, full color fills or thick cartoon contours. Nearly white light ivory paper with airy blank areas. Full figure including head, spear tip, shield and boots comfortably inside frame. No lettering, title, border, watermark or typography. Intended final portrait 1000 by 1500 WebP.
